notes.title: Update 0.0.7.0
notes.content:
[b]Version 0.0.7.0[/b]


Gameplay:

[list]
[*] Fixed time advance meter exploits.  (Thanks SapphireDrew)
[*] Standard trigger and Special triggers no longer indicate when it is safe or unsafe to activate a trigger. Instead, they will reflect the activation state.
[*] Standard triggers and special triggers will now animate between different colors sets over time.
[*] Added cube touch tolerance. This will help with the unintentional cube touches when touching Water cubes or Normal cubes with Fire Touch.
[/list]

Non-Gameplay:

[list]
[*] Fixed controls not saving to disk.
[*] Simplified settings, and fixed some keyboard / joystick selection issues in the settings screens.
[*] New resolution selector with arrows instead of dropdown.
[*] Added colorblind mode for all forms of colorblindness. For those with minor colorblindness, you may prefer to bump up your color saturation via your video card settings.
[*] Added Steamworks SDK.
[*] Added Steamworks Cloud Saves.
[*] Added 15 Steam achievements.
[*] Updated main menu button width to accommodate languages that need more space.
[*] Updated confirm delete file screen.
[*] Improved end game death / level completion screen.
[*] Improved select level details UI.
[*] Increased some font sizes.
[*] Updated world unlocked UI.
[*] The final level's end screen will now link to the credits scene.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.0.6.0
notes.content:
[b]Version 0.0.6.0[/b]


Gameplay:

[list]
[*] Added world 4, which includes the new Inversion cube type. The Inversion cube type will swap fire and water cubes, adding greater gameplay variety.
[*] Introduced player to cube patterns in earlier levels, rather than introducing them in later levels. This should make the later levels more palatable.
[*] Added Time Advance mechanic, which allows the player to increase the speed of cubes rolling.
[*] Time Warp is now known as Time Freeze.
[*] Time Freeze meter is now built up via using Time Advance, instead of clearing cubes.
[*] New trigger timings introduced. This will allow the player to activate triggers mid cube roll. This results in a larger window to clear a cube.
[*] Fixed death detection problems.
[*] A single error will now remove a slab instead of three errors.
[/list]

Non-Gameplay:

[list]
[*] Gamepad pause button no longer doubles as a submit button for UI. This was causing all strange behaviors, including a soft lock.
[*] The pause background is now opaque, to discourage pause buffering.
[*] Fixed controller binding issue where certain buttons were erroneously showing conflicts for non-used keys or buttons (on both keyboard and joystick).
[*] Pushing pause during a control action rebinding will no longer prevent the control re-mapper from being used until restarting the game.
[/list]

notes.title: A day of Crisp Cube and Q&A
notes.content: I'm going to play Crisp Cube from beginning to end, and possibly complete the game. I will be making notes of things that I have missed, so I can further develop them later.

notes.title: Update 0.0.5.0
notes.content:
[b]Version 0.0.5.0[/b]


Gameplay:

[list]
[*] Fire cube introduced. Can be cleared via triggers, and provides Fire Touch status to Mr. Crisp. He will then clear any normal cube he touches. Fire touch is lost when Mr. Crisp touches a water cube.
[*] Added World 3, which contains 10 levels, including 3-1, which is the tutorial level for the Fire cube.
[*] Introduced new dynamic speed mechanic. The speed of the level will adjust based on how the player is performing. This will make it easier for players to clear a level, but harder for players to get a Crisp Completion on a level.
[*] Time warp is now push-to-hold, with a minimum required meter to get it started. The meter can hold up to 10 seconds of time warp. Meter UI will no longer show a count of "time warps", and the meter bar will turn grey and disable the stripes when there isn't enough meter to enter time warp.
[*] Fixed an issue where players could clear water cubes before they were revealed. Previously, this could cause a level to soft lock requiring the user to restart the level.
[*] Fixed an issue where players could clear cubes from behind.
[*] Added a cube roll delay after cubes have been revealed.
[*] Fix for cubes rolling off edge not being removed from a tile. Previously, this would result in subsequent standard triggers not placing on the correct tile.
[/list]

Non-Gameplay:

[list]
[*] Overhauled all the graphics for the cubes and ground tiles.
[*] Redid cube intro animation, with dynamic per cube land sound effects.
[*] Nebula background instantly updates when changing levels instead of gradually shifting.
[*] Added cube reveal animation and sound effect.
[*] Updated sound effects:
[list]
[*] Cube landing.
[*] Cube rolling.
[*] Standard trigger place.
[*] Special trigger cleared.
[*] Special activated and removing multiple cubes.
[/list]
[*] Updated sound effect levels, so the overall mix is more balanced.
[*] Updated to Unity 2021.1.4f1.
[*] Significant improvements in performance, including reduced stutters.
[*] Added save game migration from the demo to the full game.
[*] Adjusted bloom to prevent overbloom.
[*] Added glow effect to time warp meter.
[*] Set default volume to 80% from 50%.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.0.4.0
notes.content:
[b]Version 0.0.4.0[/b]


Gameplay:

[list]
[*] Added World 2, with 5 levels including the tutorial. This world introduces the water cube.

notes.title: Update 0.0.3.0
notes.content:
[b]Version 0.0.3.0[/b]


Gameplay:

[list]
[*] Fixed Mr. Crisp not being placed in the center of a stage on odd numbered level widths.
[*] Increased volume on place standard trigger.
[*] Fixed a soft locking issue where cubes would not roll or spawn when no more cubes were actionable.
[*] Changed ground texture, from the wavy yellow pattern, to a dark grey checkered board pattern.
[*] Reduced cubes visual outline, providing greater visual clarity.
[*] Added in-game tutorial via text prompts. These will guide the player through the core gameplay concepts, and show them what buttons or keys they have bound. Currently, level 1-1 is now a tutorial, however, more will be introduced as the other cube types are introduced in future worlds.
[*] Added in-game minimap, which shows context of how large the play area is, and where the player is located in the level.
[*] Special triggers are now removed between sub sequences.
[*] Added a cube delay before a sub sequence starts rolling.
[*] Removed caustics visual effect (god rays).
[*] Special cube is now flat green in appearance.
[*] Redid Crisp UI animation for crisp sub sequences, and made the "Next" animation match the same theme.
[*] Changed sounds for trigger miss, in game pause / unpause, and crisp sequence.
[*] Reduced gameplay camera FOV to 50 and added a z offset. This means that the camera will be more zoomed in, and Mr. Crisp is positioned more towards the bottom of the screen with roughly the same amount of forward visibility. To avoid placing Mr. Crisp behind the tutorial text, the Z offset will be different on tutorial levels.
[*] Disabled points for now, as it was confusing players more than anything. This will need a rework if reintroduced.
[/list]

Non-Gameplay:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with the in game pause button not functioning appropriately.
[*] Results screen to be scaled correctly with screen density.
[*] Fixed an issue where level effects were not properly being recycled, causing unnecessary memory allocations.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.0.2.0
notes.content:
[b]Version 0.0.2.0[/b]


Gameplay:

[list]
[*] Cubes now move when they land on a tile, and not midway between rolls.
[*] Mr. Crisp will auto-dash when there a lot of room between where he is, and the active rolling cubes are. This cuts down on on a lot of dead time.
[*] Made cubes themselves roll faster, in exchange for extending the period of time when the cubes do not roll after melting a cube successfully. This makes the game feel a lot faster.
[/list]
Non-Gameplay
[list]
[*] New in game UI:
[list]
[*] Removed total time warps text.
[*] Made some of the in game UI larger.
[*] Added horizontal "candy-cane" style meter with a numbered indicator for how many time warps a player has. Includes hourglass icon.
[*] In game UI (pause menu, action score, total score, sequence progress, time warps, etc), now scale with screen resolution.
[*] Removed overlay intro, and level quotes. This allows the player to focus on the blocks animating in rather than the black overlay and text.
[/list]
[*] Fixed deselection issue on settings screen when selecting video or audio.
[*] Turned off deselection when clicking on the background, which is problematic when switching between mouse and controller.
[*] Undeveloped worlds will no longer show in the world selection screen.
[*] Fixed sounds triggering incorrectly on the campaign screen.
[*] Put the "how to play" section back in, so the UI navigation events were breaking (will show placeholder video).
[*] Changed the sound effects for normal cube removal, special cube triggered, and cubes moving (now a thud).
[*] Added visual level theme support, and applied visual themes to levels 1-1 to 1-10.
[*] In game background is now pure nebula. The 2D sprite clouds will now only show up on the main menu screen.
[*] Caustics now themed to ambient color.
[/list]
